definitions: Metal devices with a small spike or a toothed wheel that are worn on the heels of riding boots and used for urging a horse forward.
A projection from the back of a cock's leg, typically used in fighting.
A ridge or a small mountain range that projects from a main range.
A short branch line of a railway or road.
A stimulus or encouragement to an action or a greater effort.
examples: The rider dug his spurs into the horse's flanks.
The road followed a spur of the mountains.
A railway spur led to the factory.
The award was a spur to further research.
